components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant action for one local decision region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-fg); font: 500 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10); transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.50); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A secondary action that remains discoverable without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-fg); font: 400 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--color-surface-subtle); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.30); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { background: var(--color-accent-subtle); }

components.name: Compact Search Input
components.description: The dense collection search field used alongside independent filters.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="Search tasks…" aria-label="Search tasks">
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 320px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-fg); font: 400 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-fg-muted); } .ds-input-search:hover { border-color: var(--color-fg-muted); } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.50); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The singular current location inside permanent or drawer navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-fg); font: 500 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10); } .ds-nav-active:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Filter Trigger
components.description: A compact control that reveals its active filtering effect without permanent form chrome.
components.css: .ds-filter-trigger { height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent-subtle); color: var(--color-accent); font: 500 12px/16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-filter-trigger:hover { background: var(--color-surface-subtle); } .ds-filter-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.30); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-filter-trigger:active { background: var(--color-accent-subtle); }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: A non-interactive annotation for a label or small piece of supporting metadata.
components.css: .ds-metadata-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface-subtle); color: var(--color-fg-muted); font: 400 11px/16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: An independently selectable or conceptually bounded work object.
components.html:
Active milestone

Coordinate the next coherent delivery window.
components.css: .ds-surface-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-fg); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-surface-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 16px/24px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-surface-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--color-fg-muted); font: 400 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-surface-card:hover { border-color: rgb(37 99 235 / 0.40); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10); } .ds-surface-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.30); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Task Row
components.description: The compact desktop scan line with a clear but non-carded selection state.
components.html: #42Resolve dependency statusIn progressHigh
components.css: .ds-task-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-accent-subtle); color: var(--color-fg); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--color-accent); font: 400 14px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-task-row a { min-width: 0; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-task-row a:hover { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-task-row a:focus-visible { border-radius: 4px; outline: 3px solid rgb(37 99 235 / 0.30); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-task-number { width: 48px; flex: 0 0 48px; color: var(--color-fg-muted); font: 400 12px/16px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-task-property { width: 96px; flex: 0 0 96px; color: var(--color-fg-muted); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
Pactline is a modern collaborative workbench where human and Agent workstreams converge into one legible delivery path. It should feel direct, precise, and current without becoming flashy. Fast inline actions, immediate state feedback, and clear focus make it modern; ornamental effects do not.

The interface is a working surface rather than an electronic ledger. Audit and structure are trustworthy foundations, but they stay beneath a calm operating experience. Information hierarchy follows the user's next decision, so the most actionable risk, task, or outcome receives emphasis before supporting metadata.

The system evolves through focused improvements rather than a one-time visual replacement. New work should strengthen the shared hierarchy and interaction grammar while preserving familiar workflows.
keyCharacteristics: Modern and direct, without novelty for its own sake
Dense enough for daily operation, but never visually flat
Quiet at rest and unmistakable during action
Structured by user attention rather than database shape
Layered through tone, spacing, and borders before shadow

rules.name: The Accent Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Glacier Signal Blue identifies the current action or location; it must not become general decoration.

rules.name: The State Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Status, priority, danger, and selection colors must keep stable semantics across List and Gantt renderers.

rules.name: The Content Earns Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Weight and size follow workflow importance, not entity rank; a blocking condition may outrank the project name when it is the user's next decision.

rules.name: The Attention Follows Work Rule
rules.body: Visual priority must match the user's likely attention order.

rules.name: The Shared Collection Rule
rules.body: List and Gantt are renderers of the same task collection. Filters, selection, loading, errors, pagination, and mutations must keep the same placement and behavior unless the renderer requires a genuinely different interaction.

rules.name: The Layered, Not Carded Rule
rules.body: Add a card only when content is independently selectable, movable, or conceptually bounded; use spacing and dividers for ordinary grouping.

rules.name: The Radius Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Larger radii communicate a larger bounded surface; do not apply pill or prominent-surface rounding to ordinary buttons for friendliness alone.

rules.name: The Quiet at Rest Rule
rules.body: A control may recede when its value reads clearly as content, but hover, focus, open, selected, blocked, and error states must be immediately recognizable.

dos: Do order information around the user's next decision and common work sequence.
Do preserve fast inline editing and provide visible success, conflict, rollback, and undo feedback.
Do use the shared semantic palette so List and Gantt communicate the same status, priority, selection, and danger meanings.
Do use whitespace and dividers before introducing another container.
Do improve existing surfaces incrementally while converging on these shared rules.
donts: Don't make the product resemble an administrative ledger merely because its underlying records are auditable.
Don't hide the highest-priority risk or action beneath summary metadata, activity history, or entity chrome.
Don't imitate chat-shaped task capture or encourage one-line requests.
Don't turn every field, property, or content group into a bordered box or floating card.
Don't use exaggerated motion, novelty interactions, decorative gradients, or gamification to manufacture modernity.
Don't reduce desktop information density solely to satisfy mobile touch sizing; apply touch sizing according to input capability.
